newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis tumbles, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis tumbles, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers tumbled seven to two cents per bushel Thursday in reaction to more soybeans arriving at Gulf export points at a time when export demand remains light, grain dealers said.

Corn basis values were unchanged and dealers reported light export demand. South Korean buyers bought more than 200,000 tonnes of optional-origin corn early Thursday, but exporters said they doubt the deal will include U.S. corn.
Soft red winter wheat basis values were unchanged after slipping Wednesday, and hard red winter wheat basis values were steady.
